data: Spectroscopic characterization of molecules and materials. This course builds upon the fundamentals the student learned in CHEM216 and provides practical usage of key spectroscopic tools to identify various materials. Following a brief recap of the key principles covered in CHEM216, the course will extensively cover the use of infrared spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, nuclear magnetic spectroscopy, and ultraviolet spectroscopy for the structural elucidation of various materials.
